title: My Daughter-In-Law Forged My Signature And Sold My Patient Accounts. So I Voided The $860K Sale
description: I spent 33 years as a paramedic and cashed out $142,000 to build a medical billing company with my daughter-in-law. She forged my signature, sold my patient accounts for $860,000, and left me a $4,900 check. I traced the forgery through IP logs and document metadata, voided the sale, and now every claim form prints the fraud docket. #MedicalBilling #FamilyBetrayal #RevengeStory
thumb_text: SHE FORGED MY SIGNATURE AND SOLD MY ACCOUNTS
pinned_comment: What would you do if your daughter-in-law forged your signature, sold your patient accounts for $860,000, and handed you a $4,900 EOB check? Share your story in the comments.
